images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: garage | Hick

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a tiny one-room hipped-roof frame cottage (or rear house) of dark siding with one window, behind another house, in a snowy yard with a clothesline post and a grape arbour

why.note: a rear cottage on a deep lot: a first house, a rental or a workshop
